posted_text:
🏢 NJ S4400 — NJ Wants to Know: How Data Centers Are Sucking Up Water

New Jersey is asking the Department of Environmental Protection to investigate the water usage of large-scale data centers.

The bill directs a year-long study to assess both short-term and long-term impacts on drinking water, wastewater systems, and the environment.

The study will examine water consumption patterns, cooling technologies, and potential costs associated with these facilities – including impacts on public water systems and ratepayers.

The DEP can require data center operators to share detailed information, and the final report will be submitted to the Governor and the Legislature, potentially leading to new regulations on water usage by these facilities.

Oct. 8, 2026: Referred to Senate Budget and Appropriations Committee.

🔗 Read the full bill: https://www.njleg.state.nj.us/bill-search/2026/S4400
